cheats_note: Cheats disable trophies and saving; keep them off for the whole run.
missable_note: Only trophy 28 (Positive Mental Attitude) may be missable: do the Chapter 1 balcony meditation. Keep a manual save at the start of every chapter — there is no mission replay and no New Game+.

stages.guidance: Play the opening chapter and take the optional content as it appears. The one thing you must not skip: the morning at Jason's house when Lucia walks out to the balcony to meditate — follow her, accept the optional quest, and bank the missable meditation for trophy 28. Meet Cal, start Kenton's diving strand, and scan vehicles and animals as you go: early progress counts toward the 100% checklist even though it only opens after the story.
stages.title: Chapter 1: Learn Leonida, save the meditation

stages.guidance: Jason and Lucia roam together from Chapter 2, which opens the partner trophies: lose a 4-star wanted level together and rob 3 shops back-to-back. Chapter 3 opens Andy's, Randy's and Tyrone's strands plus the marked-bills laundering. Do the story missions and the side strands as they appear — some quest givers go quiet for stretches of the story, but all trophy quest givers come back.
stages.title: Chapters 2-3: Both leads, side strands open

stages.guidance: Finish the story through the Chapter 5 final mission. In Chapter 4, take the optional mission That's Where The Money Is… to open the bank vault jobs, and grab the Snap Gun from Yasmani's jewelry jobs for the undetected jewelry robbery. After the credits you keep free roam with everything still accessible — the cleanup starts now.
stages.title: Chapters 4-5: Finale and free roam

stages.guidance: The biggest stage: the 100% Completion checklist under Progress > Stats. Work the lenient lines — 300 stunts, 70 of 80 challenges, 200 of 277 vehicles, 100 of 255 animals, 50 of 66 weapons, 15 of 18 meditations — plus the lines that need everything: all shooting ranges, all 42 drone races, all robberies, all underwater discoveries and all of Bret's quests. A plane is the fastest way to unfog the map; scan with WAiNK as you fly.
stages.title: The 100% core: stunts, challenges, scans

stages.guidance: Clear the crime trophies: one illegal operation per gang (all 39 for 100%), the Kingpin Bowling valuables, the VCIA jet heist, the Mile Zero tank, 5 Combat Focus takedowns, and the 500 criminal-profile actions — most of which will already be banked from the story and the checklist grind.
stages.title: Crime pays: robberies and gang operations

stages.guidance: Finish the side strands that are still open, complete 3 card sets (keep going toward 15 of 18 for 100%), max out Strength on both characters at the gym, buy all 8 purchasable garages, register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app, and spend $100,000 across shops. By the end of this stage the trophy list should be nearly done.
stages.title: Collections and money cleanup

stages.guidance: Finish 8 stranger strands, then sweep the last loose ends: the Ocean Beach cocktail, the showroom smash, and the two unconfirmed trophies (check for fresh player confirmations before grinding them). When the last trophy pops, Vice Got a Price! — the platinum — unlocks automatically.
stages.title: Strangers, loose ends, platinum
